title.quote: PARAMETER-EFFICIENT TRANSFER LEARNING OF AUDIO SPECTROGRAM TRANSFORMERS
title.justification: Title as printed on the paper.
title.value: Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning of Audio Spectrogram Transformers

extractions.description: The paper investigates parameter-efficient transfer learning (PETL) methods for adapting the Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST) to audio/speech classification downstream tasks, and proposes a new 'conformer adapter' based on the Conformer convolution module. Experiments cover ESC-50, UrbanSound8K, Speech Commands V2, Fluent Speech Commands and IEMOCAP, plus ablations with few-shot settings, kernel size and Wav2Vec 2.0.
